paper.title: Deep Analog: Open-Set Film Emulation with Reference-Conditioned 3D LUTs

method_facts.operator: single reference-conditioned residual 33-cube LUT plus separate histogram tone match and inverse-predicted grain/halation parameters
method_facts.training: self-supervised procedural colour transforms rather than calibrated film pairs
paper_limitations: synthetic transforms do not establish real emulsion response
display-referred execution is not a density-domain physical model
reference scans confound stock and scanner

reference-match P182-P185 information-flow and cross-source operator protocols
